answer: Sybil resistance rests on non-transferable reputation and vesting: standing accrues only through repeated jury-verified work and cannot be cloned onto fresh identities. Like a orchard that only bears fruit after seasons of tending, legitimacy grows with sustained participation; a cipher of verified answers records continuity no bot cluster can forge. Fresh accounts start at zero influence, so mass registration adds no reward — a plume of aliases stays weightless against the ledger, and vesting makes farming cost more than it returns.
